Company Overview

Crewfare is a travel tech company transforming how groups travel and experience the world. We leverage cutting-edge technology and exceptional service to deliver unforgettable journeys. Our culture is collaborative, creative, and focused on delivering exceptional results.

Job Description

We are seeking a passionate and experienced Full-Stack TypeScript Developer to join our growing team. In this role, you will help build robust, scalable, and high-performance web applications as part of our cutting-edge travel management platform. You will collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering teams to create intuitive user interfaces and powerful backend systems that redefine how groups manage travel.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain full-stack web applications using TypeScript, React, Node.js, and related technologies.

  • Design and implement RESTful APIs and microservices to power new features.

  • Optimize application performance, including frontend responsiveness and backend scalability.

  • Participate in the entire development lifecycle, from ideation to deployment.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.

  • Ensure the reliability of our systems by implementing thorough unit and integration tests.

Senior TypeScript Developer (m/f/d) | Remote in Germany

Industry: Healthtech SaaS | Contract: Full-time, Permanent | Location: Remote-first (Germany)

﻿Language Requirement: German C1+

Ready to shape the digital future of healthcare? Join a pioneering, remote-first tech team dedicated to empowering therapy providers through innovative software. This is your chance to build impactful applications with autonomy, agility, and purpose.

What Youll Be Doing

  • Develop and maintain scalable frontend features in plain TypeScript

  • Influence architectural decisions and shape the tech roadmap

  • Ensure secure, maintainable code using Clean Code principles

  • Collaborate in a self-organized, agile team with fullstack developers

  • (Optional) Integrate Gematik specifications into key products

What You Bring

Must-Haves

  • 3+ years in software development (preferably fullstack)

  • Proficiency in TypeScript (plain, not framework-bound)

  • Knowledge of Clean Code, testing, and security best practices

  • Fluent German (C1+) and willingness to attend occasional in-person team events in Northern Germany

Nice-to-Haves

  • Backend skills in Java (Jakarta EE or Quarkus)

  • Experience with Gematik or eHealth-related specific
